case: domain-over-enum array_append and array_prepend parameter inference
outcome: PostgreSQL infers text and SQL NULL parameters as the base enum; ARRAY[status] retains the domain array type while array_append/array_prepend return the base enum array.
contract: Tests both array_append(ARRAY[status], $1) and array_prepend($1, ARRAY[status]).
Exercises text and SQL NULL parameters across ready, paused and SQL NULL source rows.
Checks exact array JSON, pg_typeof($1), pg_typeof(ARRAY[status]), pg_typeof(function result), and pg_typeof(status).
source_worktree: The test was run after source commit a56f1c44e. Two pre-existing .b4-f4f9-* scratch directories remain untracked outside this evidence packet.
remaining: Other PostgreSQL query contexts, enum/session configurations, remaining engines/types/consumers and the broader B3 matrix remain open; this case does not qualify 0.2.0.
